comments.body:
I moved to Switzerland for my postdoc at ETH and had my registration within a week. Insurance in a day after that. You need to move to a cheaper /more long term place first and try and get registration appointments there. 

Are you only looking at Zurich city or also surrounding areas like Schwerzenbach, Dübendorf, Uster etc.? You could find furnished apartments, Airbnbs or WGs which would be cheaper than a hotel and Moreso 20 -30 mins out of Zurich. It would also likely be faster to register there. 

Also most companies are usually ok with the registration confirmation before the actual residence permit arrives. So you should shop around for other insurance companies. Comparis.ch is useful here. Hope that helps. Good luck.
comments.author: Unnaturalempathy
